questions.question: The statement "Every Union Territory shall be administered by the President acting to such extent as he thinks fit" comes from:

options.text: Article 246(4) --- ## 📌 Master Revision Table | Article Subject | | | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | | 239 | President administers UTs through Administrator | | 239A | Legislature/Council of Ministers for Puducherry | | 239AA | Special provisions for Delhi (NCT) | | 239AB | President's Rule in Delhi | | 239B | Ordinance power of UT Administrator | | 240 | President's regulation-making power for certain UTs | | 241 | Parliament to constitute High Court for UT | | 242 | Repealed (was for Coorg) | | 246(4) | Parliament can legislate on State List for UTs | | UT Legislature LG/Admin title | | | | ------------------------------ | --- | ------------------- | | Delhi (NCT) | Yes | Lieutenant Governor | | Puducherry | Yes | Lieutenant Governor | | J&K | Yes | Lieutenant Governor | | Ladakh | No | Lieutenant Governor | | Chandigarh | No | Administrator | | Lakshadweep | No | Administrator | | Andaman & Nicobar | No | Lieutenant Governor | | Dadra-NH & Daman-Diu | No | Administrator | --- > **💡 RO/ARO Tip:** Questions on UTs heavily target **Article 239AA vs 239A**, **Ladakh without legislature**, **J&K 2019 reorganisation**, **the three reserved subjects for Delhi (Police, Land, Public Order)**, and the **number of UTs (8, not 9)**. Focus especially on Assertion-Reason type in this topic.
